stock.description: China Yurun Food Group Limited, functioning as an investment holding company, focuses its operations within the People's Republic of China on the slaughter, production, and distribution of a variety of meat products. The company's offerings include both chilled and frozen pork, alongside an assortment of low and high-temperature processed meat items. These goods are primarily sold under the well-known brand names of Yurun, Furun, Wangrun, and Haroulian. Established in 2005, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Nanjing, PRC.
